# Mixscale Protein DAP calculation for Perturbation-Specific Volcano Plots and DEG Supplementary Tables for Figure 3D,3E,3F,3J,3K,3L

# Imports
```{r imports}
library(MuDataSeurat)
library(Seurat)
library(ggridges)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(reshape2)
devtools::install_github("reetm09/MixscaleBH")
library(MixscaleBH)
library(presto)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(magick)
```

# Read Data
```{r read_data, echo="False"}

data_dir = "<path to processed data>"
cite_6tf_path = paste0(data_dir, "cite_6tf_cleaned_revisions.h5mu")
cite_imgl_path = paste0(data_dir, "cite_imgl_cleaned_revisions.h5mu")
merged_6tf_path = paste0(data_dir, "adata_revisions_merged_6tf.h5ad")

h5mu_6tf <- ReadH5MU(cite_6tf_path)
h5mu_imgl <- ReadH5MU(cite_imgl_path)
```

# Subset Data
```{r subset_data}

# remove not needed guides
guides_to_exclude <- c("FOXK1_g2", "non-targeting_g5")


# iMG
all_guides = levels(h5mu_imgl$guide)
guides_to_keep = all_guides[!all_guides %in% guides_to_exclude]

h5mu_imgl_clean <- subset(h5mu_imgl, subset = guide %in% guides_to_keep)
h5mu_imgl_clean$guide <- droplevels(h5mu_imgl_clean$guide)


# iTF
all_guides = levels(h5mu_6tf$guide)
guides_to_keep = all_guides[!all_guides %in% guides_to_exclude]

h5mu_6tf_clean <- subset(h5mu_6tf, subset = guide %in% guides_to_keep)
h5mu_6tf_clean$guide <- droplevels(h5mu_6tf_clean$guide)

```


# DEG Class
```{r set_class_for_perturb_analysis}
deg_class <- 'perturbed_gene'

Idents(object = h5mu_imgl_clean) <- deg_class
Idents(object = h5mu_6tf_clean) <- deg_class

```

# Calculate Perturb Effect
```{r calc_perturb_effect}

prot_imgl_clean <- CalcPerturbSig(
    h5mu_imgl_clean,
    assay = "prot",
    slot = "data",
    gd.class = deg_class,
    nt.cell.class = "NTC",
    reduction = "PCA",
    ndims = 40,
    num.neighbors = 20, 
    new.assay.name = "PRTB",
    verbose = TRUE,
    split.by = NULL
)

prot_6tf_clean <- CalcPerturbSig(
    h5mu_6tf_clean,
    assay = "prot",
    slot = "data",
    gd.class = deg_class,
    nt.cell.class = "NTC",
    reduction = "PCA",
    ndims = 40,
    num.neighbors = 20, 
    new.assay.name = "PRTB",
    verbose = TRUE,
    split.by = NULL
)

```


# Run Mixscale
```{r run_mixscale}

prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled <- RunMixscale(
         object = prot_imgl_clean, 
         assay = "PRTB", 
         slot = "scale.data", 
         labels = deg_class, 
         nt.class.name = "NTC", 
         fine.mode = TRUE,
         fine.mode.labels = "perturbed_guide",
         max.de.genes = 500,
         min.de.genes = 3, 
         logfc.threshold = 0,
         min.cells = 1,
         min_prop_ntgd = 0,
         de.assay = "prot",
         harmonize = FALSE,
         new.class.name = "mixscale_score", 
         verbose = TRUE, 
         split.by = NULL,
  )

prot_6tf_clean_mixscaled <- RunMixscale(
         object = prot_6tf_clean, 
         assay = "PRTB", 
         slot = "scale.data", 
         labels = deg_class, 
         nt.class.name = "NTC", 
         fine.mode = TRUE,
         fine.mode.labels = "perturbed_guide",
         max.de.genes = 500,
         min.de.genes = 3, 
         logfc.threshold = 0,
         min.cells = 1,
         min_prop_ntgd = 0,
         de.assay = "prot",
         harmonize = FALSE,
         new.class.name = "mixscale_score", 
         verbose = TRUE, 
         split.by = NULL,
     )


```

# Build Ridge Plots for genes
```{r build_ridge_plots}

RidgePlot(
    prot_6tf_clean_mixscaled,
    features = "mixscale_score",
    group.by = deg_class, sort="decreasing") + NoLegend()

RidgePlot(
    prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled,
    features = "mixscale_score",
    group.by = deg_class, sort="decreasing") + NoLegend()



```

```{r get_levels_pert_genes}
# assigning unique perturbed genes per dataframe, including all mixscale scores, even less than 0
levels_pert_genes_6tf <- levels(prot_6tf_clean_mixscaled$perturbed_gene)
levels_pert_genes_imgl <- levels(prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled$perturbed_gene)

print(levels_pert_genes_imgl == levels_pert_genes_6tf)

```

# Build Weighted DEGs
```{r build_weighted_degs}

de_res_prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled = Run_wmvRegDE(object = prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled, 
                      assay = "prot", 
                      slot = "counts",
                      labels = "perturbed_gene", 
                      nt.class.name = "NTC", 
                      PRTB_list = levels_pert_genes_imgl,
                      total_ct_labels = "nCount_prot",
                      logfc.threshold = 0, 
                      pseudocount.use = 1,
                      min.pct = 0, 
                      min.cells.group = 1,
                      split.by = NULL)


# check for each df in de_res_rna_imgl_clean_mixscaled if there are any NA values
for (gene in levels_pert_genes_imgl) {
    na_count <- sum(is.na(de_res_prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled[[gene]]$log2fc))
    if (na_count > 0) {
        print(paste0("Perturbed Gene ", gene, " has ", na_count, " NA values in log2fc"))
    } else {
        print(paste0("Perturbed Gene ", gene, " has no NA values in log2fc"))
    }
}

table(is.na(de_res_prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled))

de_res_prot_6tf_clean_mixscaled = Run_wmvRegDE(object = prot_6tf_clean_mixscaled, 
                      assay = "prot", 
                      slot = "counts",
                      labels = "perturbed_gene", 
                      nt.class.name = "NTC", 
                      PRTB_list = levels_pert_genes_6tf,
                      total_ct_labels = "nCount_prot",
                      logfc.threshold = 0, 
                      pseudocount.use = 1,
                      min.pct = 0, 
                      min.cells.group = 1,
                      split.by = NULL)

#ms_6tf <- Tool(prot_6tf_clean_mixscaled, slot = "RunMixscale")
#ms_imgl <- Tool(prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled, slot = "RunMixscale")

```


```{r save_deg_dfs}

for (perturbed_gene in levels_pert_genes_6tf) {
    de_res <- de_res_prot_6tf_clean_mixscaled[[perturbed_gene]]
    sig_de_res <- de_res[de_res$p_weight < 0.05,]
    sig_de_res$adj_p_weight <- p.adjust(sig_de_res$p_weight, method = "BH")
    de_res$adj_p_weight <- p.adjust(de_res$p_weight, method = "BH")
    write.csv(sig_de_res, file = paste0("<path to DEG directory>","merged_6tf_mixscale_degs_sig_prot_", perturbed_gene, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
     write.csv(de_res, file = paste0("<path to DEG directory>","merged_6tf_mixscale_degs_all_prot_", perturbed_gene, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

for (perturbed_gene in levels_pert_genes_imgl) {
    de_res <- de_res_prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled[[perturbed_gene]]
    sig_de_res <- de_res[de_res$p_weight < 0.05,]
    sig_de_res$adj_p_weight <- p.adjust(sig_de_res$p_weight, method = "BH")
    de_res$adj_p_weight <- p.adjust(de_res$p_weight, method = "BH")
    write.csv(sig_de_res, file = paste0("<path to DEG directory>","cite_imgl_mixscale_degs_sig_prot_", perturbed_gene, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
    write.csv(de_res, file = paste0("<path to DEG directory>","cite_imgl_mixscale_degs_all_prot_", perturbed_gene, ".csv"), row.names = FALSE)
}

```


# Save Mixscale Objects and Scores
```{r save_mixscale_objects}

out_dir <-  "<path to output processed data directory>"
saveRDS(prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled, file = paste0(out_dir, "prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled.rds"))
saveRDS(prot_6tf_clean_mixscaled, file = paste0(out_dir, "prot_6tf_clean_mixscaled.rds"))


```

``` {r saving_mixscale_score} 

filename_cite_6tf <- paste0(out_dir, "cite_6tf_prot_mixscale_score.csv")
filename_cite_imgl <- paste0(out_dir, "cite_imgl_prot_mixscale_score.csv")

write.csv(prot_6tf_clean_mixscaled@meta.data[, c("mixscale_score")], filename_cite_6tf, row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(prot_imgl_clean_mixscaled@meta.data[, c("mixscale_score")], filename_cite_imgl, row.names = TRUE)

```
